subject: Pre-invoice hold & payment cadence — OrchardCloud onboarding
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@orchardcloud.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Nair <priya.nair@orchardcloud.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor setup: payment cadence & pre-invoice hold

Hi Michael,

Hope you're well. We're moving through Redwood's vendor onboarding but Finance flagged a pre-invoice hold on our account when we uploaded the first invoice sample. My AP team asked whether Redwood requires Net45 for new vendors, and whether there's any way to accelerate receipt of funds.

Context: OrchardCloud prefers Net30 but we can accept Net45 if there's a predictable cadence. We also wanted to understand if Redwood offers any early-pay programs (vendor opt-in for accelerated remittance) or if there are standard offsets/fees associated.

I've attached the completed vendor setup form and a sample invoice for reference. Can you confirm what documentation you still need and whether we can propose Net30 for the initial 90-day window, or enroll in any accelerated remit program?

Attachments: OrchardCloud_VENDOR_SETUP_FORM.pdf, Invoice_Example.xml

Thanks,
Samir Patel
Head of Finance Operations
OrchardCloud
samir.patel@orchardcloud.com
+1 (415) 555-0198
From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@orchardcloud.com>
Cc: Priya Nair <priya.nair@orchardcloud.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor setup: payment cadence & pre-invoice hold

Thanks for the quick submission, Samir — appreciate the attachments.

Short answers up front: our default for most newly onboarded vendors is Net45. That said, we have an "Accelerated Remittance" pilot (EarlyPay) for strategic suppliers that allows payment within 10 business days in exchange for either a small discount (vendor offers 1% discount on the invoice) or an agreed financing fee structure. We can evaluate OrchardCloud for EarlyPay, but Finance needs to sign off.

Immediate next steps I'd like to take:
- Marissa (procurement) to confirm whether OrchardCloud meets the pilot criteria and suggest a proposed fee/discount split.
- Karthik, can you review the vendor form quickly and confirm we have the W-9 or equivalent?
- Samir/Priya, if you can confirm whether OrchardCloud prefers to offer a 1% discount in exchange for 10-day remittance or prefers Net30/Net45, that'll help us structure the PO.

If Finance can't approve EarlyPay, we can agree Net45 with a clear invoice cutoff and a PO draft to avoid future holds. I will loop in Finance for formal approval once procurement recommends terms.

Best,
Michael Grant
Head of Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference
michael_grant@redwood.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 08:13:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Vendor setup: payment cadence & pre-invoice hold (OrchardCloud)

Notes from internal review (procurement):

Summary: OrchardCloud is a priority partner for our telemetry integration. Vendor setup form is complete; however, their preferred cadence is Net30. Finance historically sets new vendors to Net45 pending credit and audit checks. Given the strategic nature, I recommend we offer two structured options to present to OrchardCloud:

Option A — Standard onboarding
- Net45 standard
- PO issued with explicit invoice cutoff (e.g., submitted by 5th of month for next-cycle processing)
- No early-pay enrollment initially; revisit after 90 days and 3 clean invoices

Option B — EarlyPay pilot (preferred for OrchardCloud)
- EarlyPay enrollment: payment within 10 business days of invoice
- Vendor offers a 1.5% discount on invoice amount (to cover cost of acceleration) OR Redwood offers a 0.75% financing fee (we should prefer the vendor-discount model to keep net outflow predictable)
- Pilot term: 90 days, review at end of quarter for expansion
- Requires sign-off from Olga (Finance) and legal to add EarlyPay clause to PO

Action items:
- Karthik: confirm we have a current W-9 and banking verification (ACH) from OrchardCloud.
- Olga: please advise whether Finance will accept vendor-discount model (1.5%) or if you prefer Redwood-managed financing fee.
- Michael: share preferred option with Samir and request DocuSign for the PO/EarlyPay addendum once Finance confirms.

Attached: PO_12345_DRAFT.pdf (contains both Net45 and EarlyPay addendum language for review)

-Marissa
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@orchardcloud.com>, Priya Nair <priya.nair@orchardcloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 15:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Resolution: OrchardCloud payment terms & EarlyPay enrollment options

Hi Samir / Priya — thanks for your patience while we reviewed internally. Quick update and two options to choose from so we can finalize the PO this week.

Option 1 — Standard: Net45 (default)
- Redwood will set OrchardCloud to Net45 for the initial onboarding period. PO issued; invoices processed on the monthly cadence with clear cutoff dates to avoid holds. No changes to pricing.

Option 2 — EarlyPay Enrollment (recommended if you need faster cashflow)
- Accelerated remittance: payment within 10 business days of invoice receipt.
- Financial terms: OrchardCloud would commit to a 1.5% discount on invoiced amounts in exchange for the acceleration. We modeled this as the simplest path: your accounting team issues invoices at face value and Redwood applies the EarlyPay program discount on settlement.
- Pilot: 90 days, then review performance and fee structure.

Next steps (please reply with your selection):
1) If Option 1: confirm Net45 and we'll send PO_12345 (Net45) for signature.
2) If Option 2: confirm you accept 1.5% discount for 10-day remittance and we will send a DocuSign link that includes the EarlyPay addendum; upon signature we will switch the vendor to accelerated processing.

Link to PO & addendum: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-orchardcloud-onboard
DocuSign (EarlyPay addendum): https://docusign.com/txn/XXY-ORCH-12345

If you prefer an alternate numeric split (e.g., 1% discount), let us know and we'll re-run the finance model — Olga is cc'd and can provide quick feedback. If we don't hear back by EOD Monday, we'll proceed with Option 1 (Net45) to prevent further invoice holds.

Thanks,
Michael Grant

Redwood Inference
